from: They left on a gust: does the tent hold? The world is one calm picture

sections.title: Does it hold?
sections.how: Everything a world can throw arrives at once, on one tent
sections.to: Worried: does anything stand in the morning?

sections.title: The trailer
sections.how: The large picture again: the city, the person, a million humans
sections.to: More is at stake than canvas

sections.title: The quiet before
sections.how: Down at the ground: needles, moss, a fallen branch; the air goes still
sections.to: The ground feels real, and something is coming

sections.title: What grows under the pines
sections.how: The forest fills in: thickets to push through, fern in the light
sections.to: Attached to the place: now there is something to lose

sections.title: The storm
sections.how: Wind, night and snow fall on the tent all at once
sections.to: Afraid: they do not know whether it still stands

sections.title: The morning after
sections.how: Morning: the tent stands, snow on its roof, the day turns
sections.to: Relief. The world has become a place with days and weather

sections.title: Footprints
sections.how: Footprints in the snow, and the tent's door moves
sections.to: They have to know who the second citizen is
